fabMenu.$description: FabMenu's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--fab-menu-<name>) on the page, a container or one FabMenu, and every FabMenu inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults. The button takes the Fab tokens and the panel the Menu tokens.

offset.$description: The space between the Fab and its menu (8px).
